questions.stem: A neonate is born to a mother who suffered from rubella during her pregnancy. Now the child is having cyanosis in the lower limb but the upper limbs are normal. On auscultation, continuous machinery murmur is heard. What will be the appropriate management?

options.label: A
options.text: Prostaglandin analogue- Indomethacin in the first week of life

options.label: B
options.text: Prostaglandin inhibitor- Ibuprofen in the first week of life

options.label: C
options.text: Prostaglandin analogue- Indomethacin after the first month

options.label: D
options.text: Prostaglandin inhibitor- Ibuprofen after the first month
